newsitem.title: USA: Hawaiian Electric to buy BankAmerica's Hawaiian operations.
newsitem.headline: Hawaiian Electric to buy BankAmerica's Hawaiian operations.

text.p: Hawaiian Electric Industries Inc. said Tuesday that its savings bank subsidiary, American Savings Bank, has signed a definitive agreement to acquire the Hawaii retail and commercial operations of BankAmerica.
Terms of the deal were not disclosed.
American Savings and BankAmerica-Hawaii are the third- and fourth-largest financial institutions in Hawaii.
Hawaiian Electric said the acquisition will boost American Savings' assets to $5.4 billion from the current level of $3.6 billion.
Hawaiian Electric is a diversified holding company with interests in electric utilities, banking, maritime freight transportation and residential real estate.
The stock of Hawaiian Electric was up 37.5 cents at $34.50 while BankAmerica was off $1.50 at $116.125 on the New York Stock Exchange.
